name: Elune's Grace
summary: In Darnassus, young night elf priests answer the Sisterhood of Elune's call. Their first journeys prepare them for deeper teaching from Priestess Alathea.

sections.title: A Sacred Calling
sections.body: In the Temple of the Moon, the Sisterhood guides young acolytes from their first prayers toward mastery of lunar magic. Night elves trust the Mother Moon, Elune. Humans and dwarves instead follow the Holy Light. When a novice reaches a milestone in devotion, senior mentors take notice and judge the disciple ready to bear greater divine power.

sections.title: Blessings of the Moon Goddess
sections.body: Priestess Alathea brings the Sisterhood's summons to the acolyte. She honors their devotion and welcomes them into traditions kept through millennia. By accepting the rite, the novice seals a bond with Elune. From then on, protective wards and lunar invocations of the kaldorei faith are within reach.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: The rite marks a spiritual milestone for night elf priests. It calls an acolyte back to Darnassus, where Priestess Alathea recognizes their growth and opens the Sisterhood of Elune's higher teachings.
Priestess Alathea is a respected trainer of the Sisterhood of Elune in Darnassus. She guides kaldorei priests as they deepen their communion with the Moon Goddess.

faq.q: Why is this gift specific to night elves?
faq.answer: Night elf priests worship Elune directly, while human and dwarven priests draw upon the Holy Light. The Sisterhood's invocations, including Elune's Grace, reflect lunar protection and defensive enchantments the kaldorei have cultivated for thousands of years.

faq.q: Where does this ceremony take place?
faq.answer: The summons is answered in Darnassus at the Temple of the Moon, where the city's priesthood gathers and teaches.

faq.q: Do other Alliance priests receive a similar calling?
faq.answer: Each culture follows its own path in the priesthood. Humans and dwarves study the Holy Light under their mentors in Stormwind and Ironforge, and learn disciplines distinct from the moon magic practiced by night elves.

faq.q: What state of devotion is Alathea referring to?
faq.answer: Alathea speaks of the spiritual fortitude and maturity won through trials in the wider world. Survival, discipline, and steadfast devotion to Elune's virtues show that an acolyte can safely channel stronger lunar blessings.

angles.text: As a priest, you follow the kaldorei faith, distinct from the Light based doctrines of humans and dwarves. Your craft rests in Elune's protection.
As a night elf, you inherit Elune's Grace through traditions the Sisterhood of Elune has kept through the ages.
